author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Five even rounded petals (r6 top, r5 upper sides, r6 lower) around a centre dot on a straight stem with a lens leaf to the lower left; mirrored about x=24 and reads as a flower at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The centre is a dot instead of a ring (a ring needs notches 12+ from the centre, which leaves no room for the stem and leaf); petal angles are the integer approximation 0/72/141 degrees.
